statement: In the same q=6 setup, classify admissible small-part hypergraphs of size at least four and prove the corresponding coarse balance is nonnegative, or output an exact negative configuration that survives the full trace constraints.

source_assertions.assertion: The current proof does not cover four or more small outside parts; the next target is the stated at-least-four-small-parts residual.

limitations: The scope is limited to the minimum-three-set q=6 setup and four-or-more small outside parts.
This residual does not upgrade to the general minimum-three-set case or to Frankl's conjecture.
